snippet.title: Zoo Tycoon 2 Folksy Facelift trailer
snippet.description:
The trailer for a Zoo Tycoon 2 mod I've been working on for a couple years at this point, due to release on December 20th, 2022. The mod's goal is to revamp the game in a way that respects the original art style - it modifies animal sizes and biome compatibility, adds more color variants to animals, changes a few animals to be closer to their real-life counterparts and adds a handful of new behaviors to the mix - including some consequences for not properly taking care of animals.

Visit Nano's Zoo 2 Zone, at https://sites.google.com/view/nanoszoo2zone/home, for more information. Zoo Tycoon 2: Folksy Facelift releases on December 20th, 2022.
